The Global Error Handler

The Global Error Handler is a singleton Vault service that exposes a unified, observable view of global Vault error state. It provides a centralized mechanism for observing, clearing, and reacting to errors that occur across FeatureCells and pipeline execution.

The Global Error Handler does not participate in state computation or pipeline control. It exists solely as a coordination and observation surface for error conditions that have already been normalized and committed by the Vault.

Global Error Service

The Global Error Handler is exposed as a singleton service. A single instance is shared across the application lifetime and reflects the current global Vault error state at all times.

The service provides an observable error stream that emits the latest VaultErrorShape or null when no global error is present. This allows application-level infrastructure—such as error banners, logging systems, or recovery workflows—to react consistently to error conditions without coupling to individual FeatureCells.

Responsibilities

  • Expose the current global Vault error state
  • Emit error updates through a single observable stream
  • Indicate whether a global error condition is currently active
  • Provide a controlled mechanism for clearing global errors

Clearing the global error does not modify FeatureCell state or pipeline history. It affects only the global error signal and allows error-aware consumers to resume normal operation.

Scope and Guarantees

  • The Global Error Handler is a singleton and is instantiated once
  • It reflects errors produced by Vault-managed execution only
  • It does not generate, transform, or suppress errors
  • It does not influence pipeline execution or state snapshots
  • It provides observation and coordination only

By centralizing global error visibility in a dedicated Vault service, enables consistent, predictable error handling at the application boundary while preserving strict separation between state computation and error observation.

Vault Error Service Contract
Member Description
error$: Observable<VaultErrorShape | null> Observable stream that emits the current global VaultErrorShape when an error is present, or null when no global error condition exists.
hasError: boolean Indicates whether a global Vault error condition is currently active.
clear(): void Clears the current global Vault error state. This affects only the global error signal and does not modify FeatureCell state or pipeline history.
Examples

The Global Error Handler exposes a singleton observable interface for monitoring Vault-level errors across the application. Consumers may subscribe to this service to react to global error conditions without coupling to individual FeatureCells.

Example 1: Subscribe to Global Errors

{{`// Acquire the singleton Global Error Handler
const globalError = VaultErrorService();

// Subscribe to the global error stream
const stopErrorListening = globalError.error$.subscribe(async (error: VaultErrorShape | null) => {
  if (!error || !globalError.hasError) {
    return;
  }

  // Display an application-level error dialog
  // WARNING ... this is PSUED-OCODE
  const userResponse = await showErrorDialog({
    title: 'An error occurred',
    message: error.message,
    details: error.metadata
  });

  // Wait for the user to acknowledge or dismiss the dialog
  if (userResponse === 'acknowledged') {
    // Clear the global error after it has been handled
    globalError.clear();
  }
});

// Dispose the subscription when it is no longer needed
stopErrorListening.unsubscribe();
`}}
